meta.pitch: Model your real record shelf, compartment by compartment, and always know where every record is and where the next one goes.

importForm.label: Your Discogs username

landing.title: Know where every record is, and where the next one goes.
landing.noAccount: No account needed for the demo. Sign up only when you want to save.
